title: PM Modi Unveils Sapta Dhara Framework for Viksit Bharat

blocks.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi introduced the seven-pillar Sapta Dhara framework during the 80th Independence Day address from the Red Fort in New Delhi on 15 August 2026. The framework sets a national target of Viksit Bharat by 2047 and groups growth priorities into seven streams covering industry, agriculture, technology, infrastructure, defence, energy, and soft power.

items: India observes Independence Day on 15 August every year, and the main ceremony is held at the Red Fort in New Delhi.
Viksit Bharat refers to the goal of making India a developed nation by 2047, the centenary year of Independence.
Gati Shakti is associated with integrated planning for transport, logistics, and infrastructure projects.
The blue economy is linked with fisheries, ports, shipping, offshore energy, and marine resources.
